# CES v1 Field Reference — Abstract

**Abstract-only companion**: the full Chinese text (including the complete
field table) is in [`fields.md`](fields.md). This file is an abstract-only
companion and does not modify or conflict with the generator output.

## Scope

`fields.md` is a generated artifact produced by `ces/schema/gen` from the Go
data model; it must not be hand-edited. It lists, per CES v1 type
(Experiment, Metadata, Target, SteadyState, Expectation, Tolerance, Method,
OperatorDef, Probe, ProbeSpec, Rollback, OnceSpec, CronSpec, ContinuousSpec,
Schedule, ExperimentSpec), each field with its Go type, required/optional
status, default value, constraint reference (CES-VALID rule list), and
example. Constraints point to the CES-VALID rule list rather than restating
them inline; duration fields are integer nanoseconds and must be > 0; the
experiment `seed` is a `uint64` deterministic seed generated by the CLI when
absent.
